checks.detail: TrustedEvaluatorError(RuntimeError) is the base with typed subclasses (LeaseError, PathError, BoundaryError, PromptAccessDeniedError, UnboundedResultError); ConsumeOnce hierarchy remains backward compatible; HoldoutHandle is a distinct frozen slots dataclass wrapping HoldoutConsumed and HoldoutLease.

test_consume_persists_before_returning verifies the store records the consumption before AuthorityBroker returns the receipt; TrustedEvaluator.evaluate consumes before any adapter read; denied-lease evaluation still consumes the nonce fail-closed.

deny_open_holdout_effect and HoldoutLease normalize both plain strings and SideEffect str-Enum members through the value attribute; regression tests cover enum-member denial, enum lease normalization, spec-level OPEN_HOLDOUT rejection and enum lease reads (B-1 resolved).

The focused module contains 69 tests; fresh run on the locked runtime reports 69 tests, 0 failures, OK; coverage includes traversal vectors, real directory-symlink reparse escape, nonce replay, crash-after-consume, canary leak denial, escaping evidence refs, unbounded metrics, real-holdout-open sentinel and lease denials.

Only research_automation/control_plane/final_evaluator.py and tests/test_control_plane_final_evaluator.py are changed; the four protected user files are untouched noise; no forbidden root is modified.

All self-hashed dataclasses derive deterministic *_sha256 from canonical_sha256(to_payload()); receipt/review files are valid JSON without BOM; candidate hashes cross-verify against the working-tree files.
No TODO, FIXME, XXX, HACK, debug prints, pdb/breakpoint, placeholder ellipsis, bare pass or emoji in the T4 additions.

No real Final Holdout bytes are opened, read, or imported; fixtures are tempdir fakes; _HoldoutOpenSentinel positively asserts the real holdout path is never opened; p8_authorized/campaign_authorized/final_holdout_authorized/auto_advance remain false.

advisories.detail: Initial independent quality review returned FAIL for fail-open str-Enum handling in deny_open_holdout_effect / require_evaluator_spec_holdout_free (B-1) and the lease normalization counterpart (NB-1). Implementer applied _normalize_effect and added four regression tests; re-review of the final working tree passes 69/69 and the guard is now fail-closed for both string and enum shapes.
seal_trusted_data_root and _resolve_blessed_child call underscore-prefixed entry_guard helpers; behavior is correct and tested; extracting public path-safety helpers is recommended before production.
test_reparse_escape_rejected skips on hosts without symlink privileges; it passed on this host; an explicit error-path test is recommended for CI.
_MAX_EVIDENCE_REFS, _MAX_SHA256S and _MAX_COUNTS are enforced but not each driven past their limit in a dedicated test; low risk, tracked for T6.
Root sealing normalizes case on Windows; consistent with test expectations; keep in mind for future path-equality comparisons.
